name: Noble Dollar
oneLiner: USDN is Noble chain's native rebasing yield-bearing dollar backed by short-term U.S. T-bills via M0, with T-bill yield accruing directly to USDN balances.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDN resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: Noble USDN is an M0-backed Noble deployment; base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway and Noble movement uses M0 portal infrastructure.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing Noble USDN depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list the Ethereum MinterGateway, and M0 docs describe approved-minter plus validator-gated issuance.

controls.label: M0 Noble Portal
controls.capDescription: M0 deployments list the Noble Portal on Ethereum for Noble movement; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list Noble Portal at 0x83Ae82Bd4054e815fB7B189C39D9CE670369ea16; no Noble-native mint authority address was found in the checked M0 deployment docs.

review.evidence: M0 documentation describes permissioned minter/validator rails used by M0-built stablecoins.

collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury Bills held in bankruptcy-remote SPVs via M0 Protocol; over 100% collateral coverage maintained by M0 Minters (including Superstate and MXON); collateral verified daily on-chain
pegMechanism: Rebasing yield-bearing stablecoin; USDN is collateralized by M0's $M token on Ethereum via M0's Portal bridge (Wormhole NTT); the Noble chain module tracks each holder's principal against the latest rebasing multiplier from M0 on Ethereum, accruing T-bill yield directly to USDN balances; users mint/redeem via USDC through the Noble Express app

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDN is a yield-bearing Noble Dollar built on M0 reserves; source evidence supports reserves but not a plain holder redemption policy.

genius.notes: USDN is stablecoin-adjacent but yield-bearing and built on M0 infrastructure; GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability is unresolved.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
Noble USDN materials and M0 reserve dashboard
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for USDN.

reserves.name: Short-term U.S. Treasury Bills (via M0 SPVs)
